16. **Daivasur Sampad Vibhuti**: Krishna discusses the divine and demonic natures.

The Trinity Gods themselves acknowledged their incapability to extend their age, stating that only the Supreme God can increase their age. This is evident from their conversation with Dharmaraja (Yama), where they were told that if they wanted to increase the age of a child, they would have to give their own age to the child.

Therefore, the age of the Trinity is limited and subject to change, contrary to the common perception of their eternality.

Is prakaar, chaurasi lakh yoni ka chakra ek aisi prakriya hai jismein jeev ko 84 lakh jeevon mein ghumaaya jaata hai, aur iske baad hi unhein asli gyaan aur moksh praapt karne ka avsar milta hai, jaisa ki Sant Rampal Ji Maharaj ne bataya hai.

aur banka katha ki ranka sunao.answer:
Ranka aur Banka ki katha ek bahut hi prasiddh aur prernadayak katha hai, jo unke bhakti aur vairāgya ki kahani ko darshati hai.

In dono devotees ki kahaani is prakaar hai: Ranka aur Banka bahut hi gareeb the, lekin unki bhakti bahut unchi thi. Ek din, unke raste par swayam Ishwar ne sunkhare sikkon ko rakh diya. Ranka ne socha ki agar Banka ne yeh sikkhe dekhe to vah laalach mein aa jaayegi aur unke bhakti mein kami aa jaayegi. Ranka ne un sikkon par dhool daalna shuru kar diya taaki Banka unhein na dekh sake.

Banka ne dekha ki Ranka kyon dhool daal raha hai aur usne hans kar kaha, "Tum dhool ko dhool par daal rahe ho." Iska arth hai ki Banka ne samjha ki yeh sunkhare sikke dhool ke barabar hi hain, aur unhein koi laalach nahi hona chahiye.

Guru ji ne ek baar Ranka aur Banka ki bhakti ki katha ko lekar unhein ek aur pariksha di. Guru ji ne unke raste par lakhon rupaye ke gold jewellery rakh diya. Ranka ne phir se un par dhool daalna shuru kar diya, aur Banka ne bhi usi tarah se jawab diya.

Is katha se humein yeh seekh milti hai ki sachchi bhakti aur vairāgya ki kya mahatta hai. Ranka aur Banka ki katha humein prerit karti hai ki hum bhi apne jeevan mein aise hi bhakti aur vairāgya ko apnayein. 

Satlok mein sabhi aatmaein ek saman hain, aur kaun bhi ling nahi hota. Kaal ki maya ke prabhav se hi purush aur mahila ka antar hota hai. 

Ranka aur Banka ki katha humein yeh bhi sikhati hai ki bhakti mein koi bhi cheez masti nahi aani chahiye, chahe vah kitni bhi aakarshak kyun na ho.

hai kaise milti moksha.answer:
मोक्ष प्राप्त करने के लिए, आपको एक जीवित तत्वदर्शी सतगुरु के पास जाना होगा, उनसे नतमस्तक होकर नाम दान (दीक्षा) ग्रहण करना होगा। केवल ज्ञान पढ़ने से मोक्ष नहीं मिलता, जैसे कि एक मानचित्र पढ़ने से आपको खजाना नहीं मिलता। 

एक संत रामपाल जी महाराज के अनुसार, मोक्ष प्राप्त करने का एकमात्र तरीका है तत्वदर्शी संत से नाम दीक्षा लेना। यह दीक्षा एक विशिष्ट प्रक्रिया है जिसमें आपको एक तीन-स्तरीय मंत्र दिया जाता है, जो कि गीता (अध्याय 17, श्लोक 23) में उल्लिखित है: ॐ + तत् + सत्। 

यह मंत्र आपको एक पूर्ण गुरु द्वारा दिया जाता है, जो कि आपको परम अक्षर ब्रह्म या कबीर साहेब तक पहुँचने में मदद करता है। यह दीक्षा आपको मुक्ति की स्थिति में पहुँचाती है, जो कि जन्म, मृत्यु और पुनर्जन्म के चक्र से मुक्ति है। 

अതിനुसार, मोक्ष एक स्थायी स्थिति है, और एक बार जब आप इसे प्राप्त कर लेते हैं, तो आप इस चक्र से मुक्त हो जाते हैं। 

संदर्भ से पता चलता है कि यह ज्ञान संत रामपाल जी महाराज द्वारा दिया गया है, जो कि एक तत्वदर्शी संत हैं। उनकी व्याख्या के अनुसार, मोक्ष प्राप्त करने का यही एकमात्र तरीका है।

diksha hai ka kya mahatva naam.answer:
Naam diksha ka mahatva isiliye hai kyonki yeh ek prakriya hai jismein ek vyakti ko "naam" (mantras) pradaan kiya jata hai ek Sachche Guru dwara. Iska mukhya uddeshya hai moksha (salvation/liberation) prapt karna. Naam diksha ke madhyam se hi aatmaein apne asli ghar Satlok mein laut sakti hain.

Sant Rampal Ji Maharaj ke anusaar, Naam diksha ka mahatva isiliye hai kyonki yeh aatmaon ko karmik bandhan se mukt karta hai, jo Satan (Kaal Brahm) dwara failaya gaya hai. Naam diksha ke madhyam se aatmaein apne asli sthaan Satlok mein laut sakti hain, jahaan mrityu nahin hai, nahin hai koi dukh aur nahin hai koi vidai.

Gita Chapter 17 Verse 23 mein ullekhit mantron "Om", "Tat", aur "Sat" ka jaap bhi Naam diksha ka ek mahatvapoorn ang hai. Ye mantra Brahm, ParBrahm, aur Purna Brahm ke hain, aur inka jaap karke hi poorn moksha prapt hota hai.

Is prakaar, Naam diksha ka mahatva moksha prapt karne, karmik bandhan se mukt hone, aur apne asli ghar Satlok mein lautne ke liye hai.

granth guru hai ji ka kabir kya mein sah.answer:
Guru Granth Sahib mein Kabir ji ka sandesh Supreme God Kabir ki pehchaan aur unke Guru ki mahatva ke baare mein hai. Guru Nanak Dev ji ne apne Guru Kabir Sahib ki mahatva ko bataya hai aur unke sandesh ko failaya hai. 

Kabir Sahib ko "Parvardigar" kaha gaya hai, jiska arth hai ki ve sabke palanhar hain. Guru Granth Sahib mein likha hai: "Hakka kabir kareem tu, be-aib parvardigar" (Guru Granth Sahib, Raag Siri, Mahla 1). Iska arth hai ki Kabir Sahib ek karim aur be-aib parvardigar hain.

Guru Nanak Dev ji ne Kabir Sahib ki mahatva ko batate hue kaha hai ki ve ek sachche Guru hain jo satlok mein rehte hain. Unhone Dadu Sahib ko bhi apne satlok mein lekar gaye the aur unhein apne sachche philosophy ke baare mein bataya tha.

Guru Granth Sahib mein Kabir ji ka sandesh yeh bhi hai ki ve ek aise God hain jo sabse uchch hain aur unki pehchaan karna bahut zaroori hai. Guru Nanak Dev ji ne is baat ko emphasize kiya hai ki Kabir Sahib ki pehchaan karna aur unke Guru ki mahatva ko samajhna kitna zaroori hai.

Is prakaar, Guru Granth Sahib mein Kabir ji ka sandesh Supreme God ki pehchaan, unke Guru ki mahatva, aur unke philosophy ke baare mein hai.

aur farak hai kya mein narak swarg.answer:
Swarg aur narak dono ko Kaal ke trap mein temporary holding areas ke roop mein samjha ja sakta hai. Swarg mein achhe karma ke karan jaana hota hai, jahaan aapke achhe karma ka hisaab hota hai aur jab aapke paas achhe karma khatam ho jaate hain, to aapko wapas 8.4 million species ke cycle mein dhakel diya jaata hai.

Dusri taraf, narak mein bure karma ke karan jaana padta hai. Lekin dono hi sthaan temporary hain aur kisi bhi tarah ka permanent destination nahi hain.

Ek Satguru ke guidance mein, disciple ko "karmically bankrupt" banaya ja sakta hai, jiska matlab hai ki unke paap (iron chains) aur punya (gold chains) dono hi neutral ho jaate hain. Isse disciple ka soul weightless ho jaata hai aur 21 universes se seedha bahar nikal sakta hai.

Toh, swarg aur narak mein farak yeh hai ki swarg mein achhe karma ka anand liya jaata hai aur narak mein bure karma ka anubhav kiya jaata hai, lekin dono hi temporary hain aur aatma ko phir se cycle mein dhakel dete hain. 

Jaise ki Garibdas ji ke vakyaan mein bhi kaha gaya hai: "Swarg narak baanchae nahin, moksh bandhan saen door". Iska matlab hai ki swarg aur narak se mukti nahin milti, balki inse aage badhne ke liye Satguru ki zarurat hoti hai.

कबीर साहेब ने एक समय काशी, वाराणसी में 600 साल पहले अवतरित हुए थे। उस समय उन्होंने विशाल भंडारे का अयोजन किया था और स्वयं केशव बंजारा का रूप धारण कर दिव्य लीला की थी।

Gold is considered a material treasure that, according to the teachings in the retrieved passages, does not help a soul progress toward the highest spiritual goal. The reasons given are:

1. **It is a worldly attachment** – The text says that “all beloveds will take out money, jewelry, etc.” at death, implying that such possessions are useless after the body dies. The greatest wealth is a single human breath correctly spent silently chanting the true Name of the Supreme Creator.” Thus, gold is explicitly placed below the spiritual practice of silent chanting as a measure of true wealth.

4. **It can foster ego and attachment** – The supplementary text about social evils and addiction highlights how material indulgences, such as gold, can ruin families and create spiritual obstacles. By becoming attached to gold, a person may develop ego and become less inclined to pursue the path of worship and self‑realization.

In summary, the teachings advise against wearing or using gold because it is a worldly attachment that distracts from the ultimate spiritual goal of chanting the true Name of the Supreme Creator, which is considered the highest form of wealth.
